# Time and progress

Implemented templates include `timeline`, `progress`, `countdown`, `clock`, `schedule` and `status`. Supply real dates, measured completion, explicit deadlines or observed status. Progress updates append actual events through `kanvas.progress.append`; they never imply unobserved completion. Timers use explicit supplied times and revision-bound controls. Calendar/planner data comes from the caller, not a built-in calendar integration.

Choose the exact template through current discovery. See [countdowns](countdowns.md), [task progress](task-views.md) and [template index](README.md).
